metadata.question: Does the land covered by lava flows increase in the Todoque and El Paraíso areas of La Palma between May 21, 2021 and December 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) over two windows near the target dates: Pre (2021-05-15 to 2021-06-05) and Post (2021-12-10 to 2021-12-20), filtered by the Todoque and El Paraíso buffered areas. If empty, widen date ranges; if still empty, fallback to Landsat 8/9 L2. 2. Masking strategy: For Sentinel-2, mask clouds/cirrus with QA60 and SCL (exclude cloud/shadow); for Landsat, mask QA_PIXEL clouds/shadows/cirrus. Compute NBR and dNBR. 3. Valid Zero vs Null/Error: Check collection sizes; if zero after attempts -> C1. Check valid pixel counts after masking; if zero -> C2. If any metric is null/NaN -> C3. Otherwise compare lava-proxy area (NBR<0) pre vs post; if post > pre -> A else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Helpers function getInfoAsync(obj) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.getInfo((res, err) => { if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res); }); }); } // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Approximate centers for Todoque and El Paraíso, La Palma, Canary Islands const todoque = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.8829, 28.6093]); const pariso = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.8555, 28.6070]); // "El Paraíso" approximate const bufferMeters = 1500; const region = todoque.buffer(bufferMeters).union(pariso.buffer(bufferMeters)); const preNarrow = ['2021-05-15', '2021-06-05']; const postNarrow = ['2021-12-10', '2021-12-20']; const preWide = ['2021-04-21', '2021-06-30']; const postWide = ['2021-11-15', '2021-12-31']; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Sentinel-2 masking function maskS2(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const maskQA = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); const scl = img.select('SCL'); const sclMask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)).and(scl.neq(11)); return img.updateMask(maskQA).updateMask(sclMask); } // Landsat masking and scaling (L2) function maskLsL2(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0); const cloudShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0); const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0); const mask = cloud.and(cloudShadow).and(cirrus); // Apply reflectance scaling const scaled = img .select(['SR_B5', 'SR_B7'], ['NIR', 'SWIR2']) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return scaled.updateMask(mask); } function addNBR(img, nirName, swirName) { const nir = img.select(nirName); const swir = img.select(swirName); const nbr = nir.subtract(swir).divide(nir.add(swir)).rename('NBR'); return img.addBands(nbr); } async function getS2Composite(start, end) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .map(maskS2) .select(['B8', 'B12'], ['NIR', 'SWIR2']); const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (size === 0) return { img: null, size: 0, source: 'S2' }; const med = col.median(); const withNBR = addNBR(med, 'NIR', 'SWIR2'); return { img: withNBR, size: size, source: 'S2' }; } async function getLandsatComposite(start, end) { const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end); const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end); const col = l8.merge(l9) .filterBounds(region) .map(maskLsL2); const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (size === 0) return { img: null, size: 0, source: 'Landsat' }; const med = col.median(); const withNBR = addNBR(med, 'NIR', 'SWIR2'); return { img: withNBR, size: size, source: 'Landsat' }; } async function getCompositeWithFallback(preOrPost) { const rangeNarrow = preOrPost === 'pre' ? preNarrow : postNarrow; const rangeWide = preOrPost === 'pre' ? preWide : postWide; // Try S2 narrow let res = await getS2Composite(rangeNarrow[0], rangeNarrow[1]); if (res.img) return { ...res, window: 'narrow' }; // Try S2 wide res = await getS2Composite(rangeWide[0], rangeWide[1]); if (res.img) return { ...res, window: 'wide' }; // Try Landsat narrow res = await getLandsatComposite(rangeNarrow[0], rangeNarrow[1]); if (res.img) return { ...res, window: 'narrow' }; // Try Landsat wide res = await getLandsatComposite(rangeWide[0], rangeWide[1]); if (res.img) return { ...res, window: 'wide' }; return { img: null, size: 0, source: 'None', window: 'none' }; } const preComp = await getCompositeWithFallback('pre'); const postComp = await getCompositeWithFallback('post'); if (!preComp.img || !postComp.img) { console.log(`Pre images: ${preComp.size} (${preComp.source}, ${preComp.window}), Post images: ${postComp.size} (${postComp.source}, ${postComp.window})`); console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing and Valid Pixel Checks const areaImgHa = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e4).rename('area'); function validCountAtScale(img) { // Count non-masked pixels of first band (NBR exists) const firstBand = img.bandNames().get(0); return img.select([firstBand]).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).values().get(0); } const totalCells = await getInfoAsync( ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('c') ); const preValid = await getInfoAsync(validCountAtScale(preComp.img)); const postValid = await getInfoAsync(validCountAtScale(postComp.img)); if ((preValid === null || preValid === 0) || (postValid === null || postValid === 0)) { console.log(`Pre images: ${preComp.size} (${preComp.source}, ${preComp.window}), Post images: ${postComp.size} (${postComp.source}, ${postComp.window})`); console.log(`Valid px (1000m): Pre=${preValid || 0}/${totalCells}, Post=${postValid || 0}/${totalCells}`); console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation const preNBR = preComp.img.select('NBR'); const postNBR = postComp.img.select('NBR'); const dNBR = preNBR.subtract(postNBR).rename('dNBR'); // Areas where lava likely present (very low NBR) and where strong change occurred (dNBR > 0.35) const preLavaMask = preNBR.lt(0.0); const postLavaMask = postNBR.lt(0.0); const dNBRMask = dNBR.gt(0.35); const regionAreaHa = await getInfoAsync(areaImgHa.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area')); const preLavaHa = await getInfoAsync(areaImgHa.updateMask(preLavaMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area')); const postLavaHa = await getInfoAsync(areaImgHa.updateMask(postLavaMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area')); const dNBRHa = await getInfoAsync(areaImgHa.updateMask(dNBRMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area')); const meanDNBR = await getInfoAsync(dNBR.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('dNBR')); // 5. Validation & Final Answer function invalid(x) { return x === null || x === undefined || (typeof x === 'number' && !isFinite(x)); } if ([regionAreaHa, preLavaHa, postLavaHa, dNBRHa, meanDNBR].some(invalid)) { console.log('Calculation returned null/NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const preImgsStr = `${preComp.size} (${preComp.source}, ${preComp.window})`; const postImgsStr = `${postComp.size} (${postComp.source}, ${postComp.window})`; const preValidPct = totalCells ? (100 * preValid / totalCells) : 0; const postValidPct = totalCells ? (100 * postValid / totalCells) : 0; const deltaHa = (postLavaHa || 0) - (preLavaHa || 0); // Evidence (<=20 lines) console.log(`AOI buffers: 1.5 km; Region area: ${regionAreaHa.toFixed(1)} ha`); console.log(`Pre images: ${preImgsStr}, Post images: ${postImgsStr}`); console.log(`Valid px (1000m): Pre=${preValid}/${totalCells} (${preValidPct.toFixed(0)}%), Post=${postValid}/${totalCells} (${postValidPct.toFixed(0)}%)`); console.log(`Pre lava area (NBR<0): ${Number(preLavaHa || 0).toFixed(2)} ha`); console.log(`Post lava area (NBR<0): ${Number(postLavaHa || 0).toFixed(2)} ha`); console.log(`Δ lava area: ${deltaHa.toFixed(2)} ha`); console.log(`dNBR>0.35 area: ${Number(dNBRHa || 0).toFixed(2)} ha, mean dNBR: ${Number(meanDNBR).toFixed(3)}`); const increased = deltaHa > 1; // require >1 ha increase to avoid noise console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B'); } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); try { await runAnalysis(); } catch (err) { console.log('D'); } } initEE(); ```
